title: ScaNN anisotropic query-metric View over one shared index
hypothesis: On one fixed ScaNN AVQ index, two development-selected query-length-role Givens codes improve fresh ArguAna nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by at least 0.5 percentage points over native ScaNN, while sharing all indexed vectors; Mirror-specific credit additionally requires beating the matched native query-side two-coordinate linear transform by at least 0.2 percentage points.
physical_object: One frozen Nomic Embed v1.5 INT8 ONNX encoder, one 768-D dense corpus embedding matrix, one ScaNN partition/codebook/anisotropic quantization/reorder index.
mirror_coordinate: One float32 Givens angle for each short/long query role, applied to the same two query-vector dimensions before the unchanged ScaNN searcher.
logical_multiplicity: Two query-role retrieval functions sharing the same physical corpus embeddings and serialized ScaNN index.
controls: ScaNN 1.4.2 official CPU builder with dot-product AVQ, one fixed tree, asymmetric hashing and reorder stage; no query view.
Same frozen searcher plus two role-specific Givens query views selected on development qrels.
Matched native two-coordinate linear query readout with normalized weights; if functionally identical, this falsifies Mirror-specific attribution.
Exact full-corpus cosine top-10 over the same embeddings as a ranking-quality ceiling/control.

data.candidate_corpus: All official corpus documents; no qrel-based document filtering.
data.query_split: All qid identities are partitioned by SHA256('MA1040|ArguAna|split|' + qid): first digest byte < 128 is development; otherwise audit. The split is deterministic, disjoint and independent of relevance labels.
data.query_roles: Short/long at median development query wordpiece-token count; equality belongs to short. Query text may define role before scoring; no qrel is used for role assignment.
data.fresh_audit: Audit query IDs and qrels remain unopened until the development-selected angle file and code/index config are committed.

embedding.artifact: Official INT8 ONNX export from the pinned repository snapshot used by MA-1037
embedding.pooling: Masked mean, full 768-D layer norm epsilon 1e-5, then L2 normalization, matching the model card/MA-1037 implementation.

index.implementation: ScaNN 1.4.2 CPU; dot_product; AVQ tree partitioning; asymmetric hashing; fixed float reorder.
index.search_parameters: One fixed index/config shared by every query arm; final k=10.

development.selection: Select one angle per query-length role by maximum development nDCG@10 using only the 50% hash-split development qids; tie-break on smaller absolute angle then smaller signed angle.

fresh.audit_split: Hash-split audit qids from official ArgUana test qrels.
fresh.latency: Five isolated repeated randomized arm blocks per query batch; report P50/P95 only if calibration is stable, otherwise NOT ESTABLISHED.

paid_objects: all corpus and query embeddings when retained
serialized ScaNN index files including tree, codebook and reorder data

success_gate: On the fresh audit, both nDCG@10 and Recall@10 improve by at least 0.5 pp versus native ScaNN, the Mirror code is a functional role-specific mapping, full shared index bytes are unchanged plus <=256 B code/metadata, and p95 latency is no more than 10% slower. A Mirror-specific PASS additionally requires >=0.2 pp nDCG gain over the matched native linear transform.
failure_gate: FAIL for Mirror-specific value if the linear query transform reproduces the Givens view within 1e-6 and ranking metrics exactly, or if both fresh quality gains are below 0.5 pp, or if the full payload frontier is not improved.
boundaries: One pretrained encoder, one ArgUana benchmark, CPU ScaNN 1.4.2; no GPU or production-scale latency claim.
One task collection split into query-length roles; no cross-dataset transfer claim.
ANN quality and exact retrieval quality are distinct; report both.
If query Givens aliases native linear transform, any performance movement is ordinary query-metric freedom, not Mirror-specific capacity.

protocol_amendments.reason: The initial full-length CPU embedding attempt was stopped after 18 minutes before any embedding artifact or metric was saved. To keep this screen executable and restartable, cap each official-model input at 256 tokens and checkpoint vector batches; this change was made before development selection and audit access.
changes: maximum model input length 512 to 256 tokens
unchanged: model revision and INT8 ONNX artifact
